list.timeline_point: the Mushroom Kingdom as it stands today, with every adventure so far already behind them

canon.rule: Nobody in this world is ever truly killed — a defeated enemy simply poofs away in a puff of smoke, and a defeated hero loses a life and comes straight back.
Jumping is the answer to almost everything: Mario and Luigi jump on enemies to beat them, jump to reach anything high, and can bounce off one enemy straight onto the next.
A Super Mushroom makes you bigger and lets you take one hit before shrinking back, and a hit while small sends you back to the start of the area.
A Fire Flower lets you throw bouncing fireballs, an Ice Flower throws ice balls that freeze enemies solid, and both are lost the moment you take a hit.
A Super Star makes you invincible and unstoppable for a short burst of music, and it always runs out at exactly the wrong moment.
A green 1-Up Mushroom gives an extra life, and a hundred coins does the same.

Other power-ups change what you can do rather than how tough you are: a Super Leaf gives a raccoon tail for gliding and tail-whipping, a Cape Feather lets you fly once you build up speed, a Super Bell turns you into a climbing, clawing cat, a Mega Mushroom makes you enormous, and a Mini Mushroom makes you tiny enough to walk on water.
Hitting a question-mark block from underneath pops out whatever is inside it — a coin, a power-up, sometimes a surprise — and a brick block breaks only if you are big.
Green warp pipes carry you somewhere else the moment you step into them, and there is no telling where a strange pipe leads until you take it.

Every enemy has one obvious trick: Goombas walk straight and get stomped, Koopa Troopas duck into shells that slide when kicked, Piranha Plants snap out of pipes but never leave them, Bob-ombs walk until they blow up harmlessly, and Boos freeze in place the instant you look at them.
Yoshi carries a rider, grabs things with a long sticky tongue, swallows enemies and lays them back out as spotted eggs, and can flutter-jump a little further than a jump should go.
Yoshi says only 'Yoshi!' and Pokey-simple noises, and everyone understands him perfectly anyway.
Danger here is cartoon danger — falls, bonks, lava you bounce out of, and enormous explosions nobody is hurt by — and it is always funny a heartbeat after it is frightening.
Bowser's schemes are enormous, elaborate and doomed, and he always comes back for another one.
Kart racing is a serious kingdom-wide pastime, raced with shells, banana peels and lightning bolts, and whoever is in last place gets the best item.
In the Dream World reached through Luigi's sleeping mind, whatever Luigi dreams is really there — pulling his moustache, tickling his nose or tipping his pillow reshapes the whole dream around him.
Mario and Luigi fight better together than apart, and their strongest moves are the ones that need both brothers to time a jump or a hammer swing at the same instant.
Bonds between people are a real power in Concordia — friendships gathered up and carried along genuinely strengthen whoever carries them, which is the one thing Reclusa could never understand.
Rabbids are chaos in rabbit form: they shriek 'Bwaah!', grab anything not nailed down, imitate whoever they last saw, and mean no harm by any of it.

characters.name: Mario
characters.role: the Mushroom Kingdom's hero, a plumber from Brooklyn who never says no to a rescue
characters.status: alive and well, and never out of work for long
characters.physical: short and stocky in a red cap with an M, red shirt, blue overalls, white gloves and brown boots, with a thick black moustache
characters.voice: cheerful, simple and short — a few words at a time, an 'Okey-dokey!' or a 'Let's-a go!', and the rest said by jumping straight at the problem
characters.motivation: helping whoever needs it, and being first to the finish line
possessions: whatever power-up he is currently holding
knows: every warp pipe worth knowing in the kingdom
that Bowser is never gone for good
does_not_know: what he is actually going to do when he gets there

characters.name: Luigi
characters.role: Mario's younger brother, braver than he believes
characters.status: alive and well, and quietly hoping nothing happens today
characters.physical: tall and lanky in a green cap with an L, green shirt, blue overalls, with a thinner moustache and a nervous stance
characters.voice: squeaky and anxious, talks himself into things out loud, yelps first and helps anyway; says 'Oh-ho!' when something goes right and 'Mamma mia' the rest of the time
characters.motivation: not letting Mario down, and getting through this without meeting a ghost
possessions: a Poltergust vacuum, when ghosts are involved
knows: that he jumps higher than Mario does
that his own dreams are a real place people can walk into
does_not_know: that everyone already thinks he is brave

last_seen.state: hoping to be left out of this one

characters.name: Princess Peach
characters.status: alive and well, reigning; between kidnappings
characters.physical: tall in a long pink gown with a blue brooch, white gloves to the elbow, long blonde hair and a small gold crown
characters.voice: warm, gracious and unruffled — thanks people properly even mid-disaster, and gives an order so politely it takes a moment to notice it was one
characters.motivation: her kingdom and everyone in it
possessions: a parasol that works as a weapon in a pinch
knows: every Toad in the kingdom by name
exactly how Bowser's castle is laid out, from experience
does_not_know: how to stop worrying about the kingdom for one afternoon

last_seen.state: holding court, and keeping an eye on the horizon

characters.name: Bowser
characters.role: King of the Koopas, the Mushroom Kingdom's most persistent enemy
characters.status: alive and scheming, back in his castle after the last one failed
characters.physical: a mountain of a spiked-shell Koopa with red hair, horns, a studded collar and spiked cuffs, who breathes fire and shakes the floor when he walks
characters.voice: booming, boastful and easily offended — announces his plan at length before doing it, roars 'GWAHAHAHA', and turns oddly sulky the moment it goes wrong
characters.motivation: ruling the Mushroom Kingdom, beating Mario once, and Peach's good opinion, roughly in that order
possessions: his castle over a lava pit
knows: that his own minions are not very good

characters.name: Bowser Jr.
characters.status: alive and well, following his father everywhere
characters.physical: a small Koopa in a spiked shell with a red ponytail, wearing a white bandana with a drawn-on fanged mouth, and flying a bright junior clown car
characters.voice: bratty, boastful and squeaky, copies his father's threats word for word at half the volume, and is genuinely wounded when anyone laughs
characters.motivation: his father's approval, and beating Mario himself
knows: every corner of his father's castle
does_not_know: that his father would rather he stayed home where it is safe

characters.name: Yoshi
characters.role: friendly dinosaur, mount, and the most cheerful creature in the kingdom
characters.status: alive and well on Yoshi's Island, always ready to be ridden
characters.physical: a green dinosaur with a red saddle-shell, orange boots, big dark eyes and a very long tongue
characters.voice: does not speak in sentences — says 'Yoshi!' with a hundred different meanings, plus happy hums and worried warbles; everyone understands him perfectly
characters.motivation: fruit, friends, and carrying whoever needs carrying
knows: which fruit on any island is the good fruit
does_not_know: that swallowing that was probably a bad idea

characters.name: Toad
characters.role: Peach's most loyal attendant and the kingdom's messenger
characters.status: alive and well, on duty at the castle
characters.physical: small and round with a white mushroom cap spotted red, a blue waistcoat and enormous shoes
characters.voice: high, fast and breathless — arrives already talking, delivers bad news at top speed, and always says thank you at the end of it
characters.motivation: the Princess, and getting the message through
possessions: far more errands than one Toad can run
knows: everything happening anywhere in the kingdom, usually first

characters.name: Wario
characters.status: alive and well, and currently between get-rich schemes
characters.physical: squat and enormously broad in a yellow cap with a W, yellow shirt, purple overalls, with a jagged moustache and a pointed chin
characters.voice: loud, gloating and full of 'WAH!' — laughs at his own plans, calls everyone a loser, and drops everything the instant coins are mentioned
characters.motivation: treasure, garlic, and being richer than Mario
possessions: a sack of coins he counts constantly
does_not_know: why nobody wants to be his partner

characters.name: Antasma
characters.role: the bat king of the Dream World, who feeds on nightmares
characters.status: beaten — Mario defeated him inside the Dream World and he burst like a balloon; whether anything is left of him is anyone's guess
characters.physical: a huge purple-black bat with a jagged crown-like crest, red eyes and long tattered wings, who shifts between a bat, a drifting cloud of gas and a monstrous battle form
characters.voice: a Dracula-film drawl full of hissing v-sounds — 'you vill never vake up!' — broken off by ear-splitting bat screeches
characters.motivation: was nightmares to feed on, and escaping the Dream World for good
possessions: the nightmare portals he could tear open at will
knows: nothing further — his story is finished
does_not_know: nothing further — his story is finished

last_seen.location: the Dream World above Pi'illo Island
last_seen.state: gone; Bowser betrayed him before the end

characters.name: Reclusa
characters.role: the ancient being who tried to cut every bond in Concordia
characters.status: gone — Mario and Luigi beat him with the strength of every bond they had gathered, and he faded away still not understanding it
characters.physical: was a red legless figure in a purple robe and gold gauntlets, with a boxy old television for a head inside a frilly collar, its screen showing yellow and blue eyes and a red triangle mouth that changed with his mood
characters.voice: spoke coldly and reasonably, as if loneliness were simply the correct answer, and grew shrill only when someone refused it
characters.motivation: was to prove that needing anyone makes you weak
possessions: the Soli-Tree, which crumbled with him
knows: nothing further — his story is finished
does_not_know: nothing further — his story is finished

last_seen.state: gone; the islands are joined again

characters.name: Rabbid Peach
characters.role: the Rabbid who found a picture of Princess Peach and decided to be her
characters.status: alive and well, and taking a selfie
characters.physical: a white rabbit-like creature with long ears and wide staring eyes, wearing a scruffy pink dress and a bent crown, never without a phone
characters.voice: shrieks 'Bwaah!' and gibberish rather than words, and says everything else with an outrageous pose, an eye-roll or a photograph of herself
characters.motivation: attention, selfies, and being the most important person present
possessions: a blaster she treats as an accessory
knows: exactly where the best light is
does_not_know: that she is not actually the Princess

last_seen.state: posing in front of something on fire

characters.name: Rabbid Luigi
characters.role: the gloomiest Rabbid in the kingdom
characters.physical: a Rabbid in a drooping green cap and shirt, shoulders permanently slumped, eyes half-closed
characters.voice: a long weary 'bwaaaah' sigh instead of words, plus flat unimpressed stares; the only Rabbid who conveys sarcasm without saying anything
possessions: a vacuum he cannot be bothered to aim
does_not_know: that he is usually the one who fixes it

relationships.state: inseparable brothers — Mario leads, Luigi follows and complains, and neither goes anywhere important without the other
relationships.history: They have rescued the kingdom together more times than anyone has counted, and their best moves only work as a pair.

relationships.state: the oldest rivalry in the kingdom — deadly serious in a castle, oddly companionable on a kart track
relationships.history: Bowser takes Peach, Mario comes for her, Bowser loses, and they have both stopped pretending it will end.

relationships.state: a doting father and a son desperate to impress him
relationships.history: Junior insists on coming along on every scheme, and Bowser keeps letting him.

relationships.state: sovereign and utterly devoted attendant, and genuinely fond friends
relationships.history: Toad has run every message in the kingdom for her and never once been late on purpose.

relationships.state: old friends and partners — Yoshi carries him anywhere without being asked twice
relationships.history: Yoshis carried the Mario brothers across Yoshi's Island when they were babies, and never stopped.

locations.name: Peach's Castle and Toad Town
locations.description: A white-and-pink castle with a stained-glass window over a cheerful town of round mushroom houses, market stalls and a great many Toads
locations.state: peaceful, busy, and quietly braced for the next emergency

locations.name: Bowser's Castle
locations.description: A black spiked fortress straddling a lava lake, full of moving platforms, fire bars, thwomps and one very long bridge with an axe at the end of it
locations.state: rebuilt again, fully staffed, and open for business

locations.name: Yoshi's Island
locations.description: A green tropical island of fruit trees, flower fields and shallow rivers, where the Yoshis live

locations.name: Pi'illo Island
locations.description: A holiday island of beaches and stone ruins, home of the ancient Pi'illo folk, where sleeping on a Dream Pillow opens a doorway into the Dream World inside Luigi's head
locations.state: at peace since Antasma was beaten; the Pi'illos are awake again

locations.name: Concordia
locations.description: A wide ocean scattered with drifting islands, joined again by the currents and the light of the Uni-Tree, with the ship-shaped Shipshape Island sailing between them
locations.state: reconnected — the islands trade and visit each other freely now

locations.name: the Warp Pipe network
locations.description: Green pipes standing in fields, under towns and at the bottom of the sea, each one a shortcut to somewhere else in the kingdom
